item.title: IPS social worker helps students ‘SHINE’ through program and service
item.description: Miss Chelsea English, a social worker at Shortridge High School in Indianapolis, was awarded the WISH-TV Golden Apple Award for her dedication to her students, her work in the community, and her commitment to creating a safe and positive environment for them.

item.title: Lawyers say Richard Allen appeal faces uphill climb
item.description: Two attorneys told News 8 Thursday past experience suggests the Indiana Court of Appeals is unlikely to overturn Richard Allen's conviction in the Delphi murders.

item.title: Trump signs executive order that could reclassify marijuana as a less dangerous drug
item.description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order to reclassify marijuana as a less dangerous drug, potentially reducing the tax burden on the cannabis industry and opening new avenues for medical research.
